title: Shift Differential & Overtime Optimizer
description: Model net pay across up to 4 shift configurations (day, evening, night, weekend). Calculates FLSA overtime at 1.5× with shift differentials correctly stacked into regular rate per 29 CFR §778.207. Accounts for childcare cost differential by shift type.
data_vintage: 29 U.S.C. §207 (FLSA OT); 29 CFR §778.207 (shift diff in regular rate); zero embedded rates
regulatory_citations: 29 CFR §778.207 (shift differentials in OT rate calculation)
